articles.title: Why silver prices cratered on a reported Russian proposal to re-dollarize
articles.summary: Bloomberg reported an unconfirmed package of proposals from Russia offering the U.S. economic partnership in energy and natural resources projects, and a commitment towards the dollar system

articles.title: My brother-in-law invested $30K in our California condo. It has a 3% mortgage rate. He’s pushing me to sell. Is now a good time?
articles.summary: “We’re only breaking even because of rising HOA fees in this state.”

articles.title: This trucking company is AI’s latest casualty, as its stock suffers worst day in more than 6 years
articles.summary: Shares of C.H. Robinson Worldwide on Thursday headed for their steepest drop ever, as investors seemed to focus their fears about AI disruption onto the transportation and logistics company.

articles.title: Applied Materials’ stock jumps after earnings. The CEO just made a bold prediction for the chip sector.
articles.summary: Applied Materials expects to see more than 20% growth in semiconductor-equipment revenue this year as AI potentially lifts overall chip-industry sales to $1 trillion.

articles.title: Arista succeeds where Cisco came up short — to the benefit of its stock
articles.summary: Arista did a better job than networking rival Cisco when it came to calming margin fears and refocusing attention around AI.

articles.title: Energy is the best-performing sector in the S&P 500 so far this year — and it’s not just because of the rise in oil prices
articles.summary: The energy sector has been the best-performing sector in the S&P 500 this year — and it’s not just because risks to global oil flows, tied to Venezuela and Iran, have boosted crude prices by nearly 10%.

articles.title: Rivian’s stock jumps as investors cheer big growth potential this year
articles.summary: Rivian expects to deliver up to 67,000 EVs this year but could dole out more than $2.1 billion on capital expenditures as it expands its roadmap.

articles.title: Coinbase swings to surprise loss amid crypto exodus, but says traders are buying the dip
articles.summary: The crypto exchange’s stock bounced off a two-year low as it looked to ease investor worries amid a sharp crypto selloff.

articles.title: Airbnb expects a continued travel rebound this year, as it banks on new services
articles.summary: The vacation-rental platform is also moving deeper into an industry it once sought to disrupt — hotels.

articles.title: DraftKings’ stock sinks as investors balk at the high cost of a push into prediction markets
articles.summary: The sports-betting company sees “a massive, incremental opportunity” in the hot world of prediction markets.
